subject: Architecture playbook & technical demo — proposed timing and stakeholders
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@fast-retail.com>
Cc: Priya Kumar <pkumar@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T16:12:00Z
Subject: Architecture playbook & technical demo — proposed timing and stakeholders

Hi Jamal / Priya,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great to hear more about the latency SLAs and data residency constraints for Fast Retail's recommendation pipeline. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a 75–90 minute technical deep-dive to walk your engineering and infra teams through our migration playbook, compatibility checklist, and a short demo of the fit-for-purpose runtime optimizations (KV caching, batch shaping, quantization impact).

Proposed agenda (high level):
- 5m quick intros and scope
- 25m current system review & migration risks (you)
- 30m Redwood architecture & migration playbook
- 20m live demo: throughput/latency knobs + fallback strategies
- 10m next steps / mutual action items

Who on your side should be in the room? We expect the following Redwood attendees: myself (solutions lead), Rishi Malhotra (serving architect), Marissa Cole (customer success). If you'd like to loop in procurement or security we can keep them as optional.

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue Jun 29, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 30, 08:00–09:30
- Thu Jul 1, 13:00–14:30

If none of these work, send a couple options or we can send a Doodle. I attached the current architecture playbook and a short demo runbook so your team can scan ahead of time.

Cheers,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172
[Attachment: redwood-arch-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: demo-runbook-90min.odt (ODT)]

From: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@fast-retail.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kumar <pkumar@acme.com>, ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T00:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Architecture playbook & technical demo — proposed timing and stakeholders

Hi Lauren,

Thanks — this looks good and the agenda is aligned to what we need. Quick notes on attendees from our side: Priya (infra), me (tech lead), and I'll try to get our security lead (Tess) on the invite as optional. Procurement is cc'd to start budget paperwork if the PoC looks green.

Availability: Tue Jun 29 at 10:00 PST is conflicting for us (monthly ops review). The Jun 30 08:00 PST slot should work but I need to confirm with Tess. Thu Jul 1 13:00 PST looks open.

Can Rishi and Marissa join the Jun 30 slot? If Rishi can't do Jun 30 morning, can we do Thu Jul 1 at 13:00 PST instead? We prefer earlier in the week but will accommodate.

Also—quick ask: on the playbook PDF, can you flag sections that directly address cross-region KV cache warmup and model variant fallbacks? I'll point our infra folks to those pages.

Best,
Jamal

I'll also annotate the playbook sections you asked for and upload a short two-page excerpt with the KV cache and fallback guidance. Attaching that excerpt to keep the pre-read lightweight.
